label: Ockham rejected scholastic realism of universals in favor of parsimonious nominalism
description: William of Ockham engaged in a direct critique of Thomas Aquinas's foundational principles, rejecting core axioms in favor of a dialectically opposed framework.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Thomas Aquinas's perspective to William of Ockham's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Medieval & Islamic Golden Age era.
